children.name: title
children.characters:
Design the page in Figma.
Ship it without a release.

children.name: lead
children.characters: Dedal turns a Figma frame built from your design system into a typed template, fills it with data from your APIs and serves it to your frontend. Rearranging a screen is a publish, not a deploy.

children.name: Designers compose the page from design-system components.
children.characters: Designers compose the page from design-system components.

children.name: Converted, validated against the contract, stored and versioned.
children.characters: Converted, validated against the contract, stored and versioned.

children.name: Selectors place data from your APIs. Missing data has rules.
children.characters: Selectors place data from your APIs. Missing data has rules.

children.name: The frontend maps names to your components. Nothing else changes.
children.characters: The frontend maps names to your components. Nothing else changes.

children.name: title
children.characters:
Three things change at different speeds.
Keep them apart.

children.name: subtitle
children.characters: Structure, data and components have different owners. Dedal joins them at the last moment, so each one can change on its own schedule.
